SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: ALPHA MAP (tn800): a0.0->0.8842, a0.02->0.8852 (champion, iter-12), a0.03->0.8828 (iter-13). Shallow interior optimum ~a0.02; architecture plateaus ~0.885 across ALL exhausted lever families (k, alpha, lr, width-hurts, data-diversity-saturates, compute-flat). (2) FAILURE MODE: none active; the task now is to CHARACTERIZE the ~0.885 plateaus run-to-run noise band (needed for honest reporting; the +-0.001 deltas between iter-8/10/12 are suspected GPU/seed noise, not signal). (3) ONE KNOB (from champion iter-12): seed 42 -> 43. All else = iter-12 (c16,tn800,ep60,k1,a0.02,lr1e-3). (4) HYPOTHESIS: a seed replicate of the champion lands within +-0.002 of 0.8852, confirming the recent sub-0.001 improvements are noise and the true plateau is ~0.885. FALSIFIER: if hr swings > 0.005 from 0.8852, the search is seed-noise-limited and single-run deltas are unreliable -> report the plateau as a mean over replicates. (5) BUDGET: ep60/tn800 = ~1140s, in budget. (6) Loop to iter-20 (seed replicates to finish per plateau).
